card.name: Mixed positions that predict 'completely'
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'www' in a 'http://www.newadvent.org' citation link, plus scattered unrelated words such as 'of', 'shot', 'at' or a partial word. Nothing links the scattered ones.

modes.label: www in newadvent link
modes.description: The 'www' at the start of a newadvent.org Catholic Encyclopedia citation URL.

modes.label: Scattered ordinary words
modes.description: Short words or word parts in running prose, where an intensifier like 'completely' could plausibly follow.
modes.example: Your resting heart rate is the number of times your heart beats per minute while it’s<< at>> rest.

card.writes: It pushes the output toward 'completely' and 'entirely' in several languages, and away from 'com' endings.
card.plain: It mostly fires on 'www' in encyclopedia web links, with a few scattered ordinary words, and it nudges the model toward writing 'completely'.
